sources.title: WagnerT7/investor-behavior-analysis - GitHub
sources.snippet: Overview Machine Learning project using Brazilian CVM public data to analyze investor behavior, identify patterns and predict risk profiles. The project combines clustering, time series forecasting, predictive modeling and AI-generated executive reports.

sources.title: GitHub - faiza141/INVESTOR_BEHAVIOUR: to analyze investor behavior ...
sources.snippet: The dataset used in this project is synthetic and self-created to simulate real-world mutual fund investor behavior. No confidential or proprietary data was used.
